title: fix(core): remove searchMetadata
body:
This is redundant with `search.status === 'stalled'`, so all relevant places have been removed:

- rendering no longer sets searchMetadata
- not used in connectSearchBox
- Widgets use `instance.status === 'stalled'` instead

Note that for now `isSearchStalled` is still exposed from connectSearchBox as in SearchBox.vue `this.state.instantSearchInstance.status === 'stalled'` breaks an unrelated test, likely related to the timing difference between reading a state and the class. Not ideal but I couldn't find a workaround. Maybe this won't be needed anymore once we have common components?

[FX-3196]

BREAKING CHANGE: `searchMetadata` is not exposed on rendering widgets, use `instance.status === 'stalled'` instead.
